convert_model_to_MOLE_model: convert a PyTorch model to a MOLE model by replacing linear layers with MOLE expert layers
replace_linear_with_MOLE: replace an existing linear module with a MOLE or MOLEDGL layer using cached expert tensors
recursive_replace_so2_linear: recursively replace all linear layers inside SO2_Convolution modules with a provided replacement factory
recursive_replace_all_linear: recursively replace all torch.nn.Linear layers in a model with a provided replacement factory
model_search_and_replace: search model blocks by index and apply a module search function with a replacement factory
